name: Hi-mi-tsu
source:
Girls becoming of age have many secrets which are worse than death to many of them. Why don't you peek at these embarrassing secrets that rarely get known to the public?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-february-2003-routes.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
步入成年的少女们藏着许多秘密，其中不少一旦曝光，简直比死还难受。何不偷偷窥视这些鲜少为外人知晓、令人无地自容的秘密？

[译自 [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-february-2003-routes.html]vndbreview[/url]]
